answer: A Sybil-resistant AI economy secures identity through proof-of-beacon tokens: each new agent node must plant a unique seed-haven, registering cryptographic proofs that grow into verifiable vine-certificates. These certificates cross-reference physical attestations and computational work, making fake-identity attacks prohibitively expensive—an adversary would need to simultaneously compromise scarce real-world anchors (haven), replicate resource-intensive beacon issuance, and sustain entangled vine-linking across the network without detection.
